scientific_integrity.proof_scope: Analytic exact rational-transform pole and Laurent-coefficient analysis with auxiliary exact arithmetic checks
scientific_integrity.remaining_priority_risk: Unindexed equivalent results in phase-type identifiability theory or earlier molecular-event timing literature

scientific_limitations: Exact continuous first-passage-time law under stable proteins, initially zero protein copies, an independent finite-stage Erlang gene-replication clock, and strictly amplified post-replication Poisson births. The theorem concerns structural identifiability, not finite-sample recoverability; close poles cause ill-conditioning. Other models and initial conditions are excluded.
title: Sharp structural identifiability of a replication-gated protein timing clock
